look_here_first: Locate the conspicuous FEATHERY/STICKY THREE-BRACT CAGE just below a flower or around a developing fruit. Then inspect downy stems/leaves, coarse lobing, and odor if safely handled. Compare mature fruit texture/color carefully with introduced scarletfruit P. lanuginosa. Don't ID the local/native-concept plant using any globally labeled P. foetida photo alone.

lookalikes.differences: The sticky finely divided bract cage plus dense hairiness and odor are stronger than flower color alone. San Antonio-area lookalikes can be introduced P. ciliata/lanuginosa-type plants.
